newsitem.title: RUSSIA: High Russian beet output target seen unrealistic.
newsitem.headline: High Russian beet output target seen unrealistic.

text.p: Russia has targeted a higher sugar beet harvest of 22 million tonnes for 1997, but a senior industry source said final output would probably be flat at 1996's 16 million tonnes.

"The government has targeted 22 million tonnes, but I see 16 million tonnes, give or take a little," said Viktor Sukhachyov, deputy chairman of the Rossakhsvyokla sugar beet producers' association. "We don't have (output) plans any more," he said.
Last year's official harvest was 16.1 million tonnes, far below 1995's 19.1 million and the annual average for 1991-1995 of 21.7 million.
